description: Smart multi-field form-filling and input inspector. Call with scan:true (or empty) to get a lightweight list of all editable inputs on the page without dumping the full DOM. Fill multiple fields in a single turn.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

blast_mode.description: Fill all fields simultaneously in a single CDP eval round-trip.

fields.description: Array of field ref+value pairs to fill sequentially.

name.description: HTML name attribute of the field.

ref.description: Element ref ID (w:NN) from browser_map or input scan.

value.description: Value to fill/select/type into the field.

scan.description: Set true to discover and return all fillable inputs on the page (with ref IDs, types, and values) in ~30 tokens without full browser_map.

scan_only.description: Validate field types without mutating DOM.

submit.description: Optional ref ID (w:NN) of a submit button to click after filling all fields.

name: browser_fill
